name: Alliance Relations
label: Quest
description: Alliance Relations: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Burning Blade have many agendas, but know that they are evil to their core, their spirits corrupted, and their destruction is the only way to thwart their objectives.
Keldran sent Maurin with me because of his knowledge of the Blade and their warlock ways.
He has control of our plots against the Blade while I deal with the other demonic threats here in Desolace.
Speak to him, and he will guide you in his designs.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. Aid from those loyal to the Warchief is always appreciated.
My name is Maurin. I am here at the behest of Keldran and the Warchief cub Thrall. It is my desire to aid the youngling leader against the evils that threaten his rule.
Come, come closer, adventurer. I shall explain to you my plan for removing the festering boil that is the Burning Blade.
